# DOC-SKILL-002 Scoring Summary

## Overall status
No production routing is approved. No canonical routing-table update is made. Local Codex remains final decision-maker.

## Candidate notes
| Model | Price Metadata | Quality Status | Evidence |
|-------|---------------|----------------|----------|
| openai/gpt-oss-20b | CHEAPER_THAN_GPT54 | CANDIDATE_NOT_APPROVED | Structured outputs and tool support present in catalog; no 5.4 documentation-skill live evidence yet |
| openai/gpt-oss-120b | CHEAPER_THAN_GPT54 | CANDIDATE_NOT_APPROVED | Stronger OpenAI-family candidate; no replacement approval |

Price metadata is not quality evidence. Neither candidate has replaced 5.4.

## HOLD / UNKNOWN / experiment-only notes
- **minimax/minimax-m3**: **HOLD** — prior schema projection and provider compatibility concerns
- **openrouter/auto**: **EXPERIMENT_ONLY** — mini batch showed cost regression for DOC-SKILL-001 and `finish_reason=length` for DOC-SKILL-002. Auto Router is not broadly confirmed.
- **unknown/provider-placeholder**: **UNKNOWN** — insufficient catalog and scoring evidence

HOLD remains HOLD. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN. EXPERIMENT_ONLY remains experiment-only.

## Boundaries
- OpenRouter is not globally approved
- No candidate is promoted to approved status
- Cheaper catalog price is not replacement proof
- Evidence is insufficient for any candidate to proceed to live comparison

## Next safe step
Complete fixture and baseline work against the local 5.4 baseline before any live OpenRouter comparison.
